preparation_checklist: Bring a valid photo ID every day — required at Interchange (Village Church & St. Mark AME) and Jewish Community Pantry
Call The Gathering (414-272-4122) before your first visit to confirm no appointment is needed
Call St. Vincent de Paul Harambee Kitchen (414-249-3866) to confirm cost and any entry requirements
Call St. Vincent de Paul Cross Roads Kitchen (414-649-9555) for Sunday visit confirmation
Call Capuchin House of Peace (414-933-1300) to confirm hours — last verified 2024
Call COA Goldin Center (414-265-7696) to confirm Sat hours and that they serve 53206 — last verified 2024
Call Maccanon Brown (414-404-0600) to confirm Tue pantry hours and that they serve 53206 — last verified 2024
Call Ebenezer Stone Ministries (414-488-8070) to confirm the pop-up is running Sat Sep 12 and serves 53206
At every pantry, ask specifically for no-cook or ready-to-eat items — you have no kitchen
Scott Christian Youth & Family Center (414-374-3923) is a backup pantry + meals Mon–Fri if other sites are closed — call to confirm service area
unmet_needs: No kitchen — all pantry items must be no-cook or ready-to-eat; confirm availability at each site
Saturday (Sep 12) and Sunday (Sep 13) have no confirmed breakfast service
Thursday (Sep 10) has a midday meal gap
Pantry quantities are unknown at every site — stock cannot be guaranteed
res-003 (Fresh Fixture Mobile Market) excluded — paid option, zero budget
data.explanation: You have zero budget and no kitchen, so the plan prioritizes free hot meals (no prep needed) and pantries that carry no-cook items. Three verified meal programs — The Gathering, St. Vincent de Paul, and Scott Christian — anchor most days. Pantry visits are flagged conditional because quantities are unknown and some require you to ask for no-cook items. res-003 (paid mobile market) is excluded. Call ahead to confirm hours haven't changed; records from 2024 are marked "call to confirm."
